mustFix.title: Seven basedOn roles still vest last-heading custody in D-321, so the subject asserts two different last headings at once and its own findingDisposition claim that d331 is the sole last-heading claimant is false on the subject's own bytes
mustFix.finding: The subject carries nine present-tense last-heading custody claims. Two name D-331: basedOn.d331.role ('Last live heading at dispatch. Last-heading custody only.') and basedOn.d321.role ('Historical last-heading of g19 leftover-join.v6. ... Last-heading custody remains D-331.'). The other seven read verbatim 'Last-heading custody remains D-321.' and sit at basedOn.d299.role, basedOn.d291.role, basedOn.d222.role, basedOn.d194.role, basedOn.d256.role, basedOn.d284.role and basedOn.d290.role. D-321 is not the last heading of this artifact. The live last heading is D-331 at COORD line 19574 of 315 '## D-' headings, subject line 'D-331: record g19-fixture-corpus.v3 as G19 leftover-design per-D-002-platform copies of the twelve D-299 implementations', resolving to HEAD 91c2dd2a9780f6a746650a8542d14fd0ff06523d, which is the same commit the subject pins at $.head and at recordedInputs.HEAD. D-321 resolves to a126647a5456b9511b5ae6e6387aab67dc530e5f, 'D-321: record g30 leftover-join.v8 as G30 leftover remasurement' - a G30 recording that the subject itself demotes to 'Historical last-heading of g19 leftover-join.v6' and 'Not last-heading of g19 leftover-join.v7' one leaf earlier. The seven strings are therefore not merely stale, they are contradicted inside the same object by the two leaves that were updated. The defect is unedited carry-forward, established by byte comparison against the frozen predecessor: g19 leftover-join.v6 contains exactly seven 'Last-heading custody remains D-321' occurrences and zero D-331 occurrences, which was correct for v6 because D-321 was v6's last heading; g19 leftover-join.v7 contains those same seven occurrences unchanged and adds two D-331 occurrences. The remasurement updated the two custody leaves and left the other seven at the predecessor's value. This directly falsifies the subject's own $.findingDisposition.lastHeadingCustody, which reads in full 'basedOn.d331.role is the sole last-heading claimant.' - d331 is not the sole claimant; it is outnumbered seven to two by claimants naming a superseded decision. It also breaks the dispatch instruction that basedOn.d331.role is the sole last-heading claimant, and it is the listed attack 'last-heading custody is not D-331' landing on the subject rather than being refuted by it.
mustFix.whyMustFix: Last-heading custody is the mechanism by which a leftover remasurement establishes it measures live HEAD rather than a stale one. A reader taking the subject's roles at face value gets D-321 seven times out of nine and would conclude this artifact was measured at the G30 recording, one heading and ten COORD entries behind the g19-fixture-corpus.v3 recording it exists to consume. A recording built on those bytes would pin a G19 leftover remasurement whose custody statements point at a decision the same artifact calls historical. The internal contradiction is not resolvable by a reader from the bytes alone: nothing in the subject marks the seven as historical narration, and each is phrased identically to the two that are meant to be authoritative.
mustFix.requiredRepair: At all seven leaves - basedOn.d299.role, basedOn.d291.role, basedOn.d222.role, basedOn.d194.role, basedOn.d256.role, basedOn.d284.role and basedOn.d290.role - replace 'Last-heading custody remains D-321.' with 'Last-heading custody remains D-331.' so that every custody claim in the artifact names the live last heading and $.findingDisposition.lastHeadingCustody becomes true of the bytes. Do not weaken findingDisposition.lastHeadingCustody to accommodate the stale strings; the frozen peer convention is uniformity, not a narrowed disposition.
mustFix.evidence: grep -o 'Last-heading custody remains D-[0-9]*' yields, on g19 leftover-join.v6: 7x D-321, 0x D-331. On g19 leftover-join.v7: 7x D-321, 2x D-331. Per-key attribution in v7: d322 -> D-331, d321 -> D-331, d299 -> D-321, d291 -> D-321, d222 -> D-321, d194 -> D-321, d256 -> D-321, d284 -> D-321, d290 -> D-321.

mustFix.title: The v5 predecessor leaf still declares g19 leftover-join.v5 the current G19 leftover remasurement, contradicting D-322, contradicting the v6 leaf that makes the same claim for v6, and contradicting the subject's own doesNot entry forbidding exactly that claim
mustFix.finding: basedOn.predecessorV5.role reads in full: 'Predecessor. Unmoved. Recorded at D-291 as the current G19 leftover remasurement. Dual ACCEPT 0/0. leftoverDesign [OBL-G19-FX-AUTHORING]. namedCorpusNotAuthored listed the two occupancy v2 classes as unauthored. g19 leftover-join.v5 remains current until a recordable successor is adopted. Not this artifact's version number.' The sentence 'g19 leftover-join.v5 remains current until a recordable successor is adopted.' is present tense and false. A recordable successor was adopted: D-322 at commit 8a685c8c1a53b7ad7a88a14a8e95a152b60e79ad, subject line 'D-322: record g19 leftover-join.v6 as G19 leftover remasurement'. The subject knows this everywhere else. basedOn.d322.role says D-322 'Recorded g19 leftover-join.v6 as G19 leftover remasurement'; basedOn.predecessorV6.role says 'Recorded at D-322 as the current G19 leftover remasurement' and 'g19 leftover-join.v6 remains current until a recordable successor is adopted'; registerRowNote says 'g19 leftover-join.v6 (D-322) remains the current recorded G19 leftover remasurement until a recordable successor is adopted'. The subject thus contains two mutually exclusive present-tense currency claims - v5 remains current, and v6 remains current - governed by the identical trailing condition, so no reading reconciles them. It also contradicts the subject's own prohibition list, which carries 'Does not record g19 leftover-join.v5 as current.' at doesNot[33]. The predecessorV5 leaf carries no staleness marker of any kind: a scan of every v5-bearing sentence in the artifact returns only 'v5 remains current until a recordable successor is adopted.' and the doesNot prohibition; the words 'historical' and 'not current' never attach to v5. Like M-1 this is unedited carry-forward - the sentence is byte-identical to basedOn.predecessorV5.role in frozen g19 leftover-join.v6, where it was true because v6 was then an unrecorded candidate and v5 was the standing recording. D-322 falsified it, and the successor did not remasure it. This is the listed attack 'current G19 leftover remasurement is still spoken as g19 leftover-join.v5', and it contradicts the dispatch statement that frozen g19 leftover-join.v5 is historical.
mustFix.whyMustFix: Currency of the standing remasurement is the single fact a downstream D-000 recording reads off this artifact to know what it is superseding. An artifact that names two different versions as current, with no marker separating the live claim from the dead one, cannot be recorded without the recorder choosing between them on evidence the artifact does not supply. The defect class is precedented as blocking in this lineage: frozen g20 leftover-join.v5 was REJECTed on Claude MUST-FIX-1 for exactly this - 'sdkJoinV4.role cited sdk leftover-join.v5 as current'.
mustFix.requiredRepair: Rewrite the tail of basedOn.predecessorV5.role to mark v5 historical and redirect currency to the standing recording, following the frozen peer convention: replace 'g19 leftover-join.v5 remains current until a recordable successor is adopted.' with wording of the form 'Historical after D-322. Current recorded G19 leftover remasurement is g19 leftover-join.v6 (D-322) until a recordable successor is adopted.' Leave basedOn.predecessorV6.role's currency sentence standing, since v6 is in fact current.
mustFix.evidence: The two 'remains current until a recordable successor is adopted' occurrences in the subject are 'g19 leftover-join.v6 remains current...' and 'g19 leftover-join.v5 remains current...'. The v5 sentence is byte-identical to the corresponding leaf in frozen g19 leftover-join.v6 (374f4426f91c575a96b89ae591632d6e2ae4bc2c92a2f44f8d57a2cf68f4e729).

comparativeConvention.method: Both MUST-FIX findings were tested against frozen peer leftover-joins that carry the same leaf shapes and were themselves accepted, to establish that the defects are departures from the lineage's convention rather than tolerated style.
comparativeConvention.lastHeadingUniformity: Every recently recorded peer holds last-heading custody uniformly at a single decision equal to its own last heading at dispatch: g20 leftover-join.v16 13x D-329, sdk leftover-join.v9 5x D-328, g20 leftover-join.v11 10x D-327, and frozen g19 leftover-join.v6 itself 7x D-321. g20 leftover-join.v16 applies the rule even to a leaf whose own subject is a superseded last heading: its d322 leaf reads 'Historical last-heading of g20 leftover-join.v9. ... Last-heading custody remains D-329.' The subject is the only one of these that splits custody across two decisions.
comparativeConvention.supersededPredecessorMarking: Peers reserve 'remains current until a recordable successor is adopted' for the one standing recording and mark superseded ancestors explicitly. g20 leftover-join.v16 says it of predecessorV11 (the D-328 recording) while its predecessorV6 leaf reads 'Historical after D-323. Current recorded G20 leftover remasurement is g20 leftover-join.v11 (D-328) until a recordable successor is adopted', and its sdkJoinV6 leaf reads 'Historical after D-329. Current DR-125 leftover remasurement is sdk leftover-join.v9 (D-329).' The subject applies the standing-recording phrasing to two versions at once and supplies no historical marker for the superseded one.
